Transfusion should start within 30 minutes of the unit leaving controlled refrigeration, because after that the blood may warm enough to raise the risk of bacterial growth and red cell deterioration. The usual standard also calls for the transfusion to be finished within 4 hours of the unit leaving refrigeration. Units that haven't been started within the 30-minute window are generally returned to the blood bank or discarded, depending on local policy.
